{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-l2wd","title":"accept_authenticated_schc_packet ignores DIO admission counter floor","description":"File: rust/lichen-schc/src/link.rs

Python LinkLayer.accept_authenticated_schc_packet rejects ingress when logical_counter(epoch, seqnum) <= the DIO issuance admitted_counter (test_peer_policy_gates_unfragmented_ingress_and_egress, match 'predates'). AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver::receive_frame in this crate already rejects counter <= admission_floor.

accept_authenticated_schc_packet never compares the data frame counter to peer.authenticated_counter(). Link replay can still accept an in-window older seqnum that was not yet seen (DIO at N, delayed data at N-k). That packet is then decompressed under the newer peer SCHC policy.
